objections.objection: The record simultaneously flags a separate, unresolved global-route path-looping-around-the-macro mechanism (#5971) as a suspected cause of the same congestion; the parameter change is reported to let GRT finish while that structural cause remains open, so the episode treats a symptom-level knob tweak as sufficient without showing the looping contribution was negligible.

mechanism_check: Reducing the global-routing layer adjustment from 0.45 to 0.2 is hypothesized to relax an overly aggressive capacity derate that was producing artificial congestion; increasing congestion iterations from the default 30 to 35 supplies additional effort to resolve residual overflows. Together these two parameter changes are reported to allow GRT to complete. The causal chain is internally consistent with the stated hypothesis and the quoted member statement, yet it leaves the independently-tracked macro-looping path (#5971) unaddressed, so the mechanism only partially accounts for the original observation.
evidence_check: post_state is merely asserted ('we could finish GRT', 'complete BoomTile'); the record explicitly states that no re-measured DRC count, overflow metric, or runtime was supplied after the parameter change.
attribution_check: direct_quote is correctly attributed to named participant eder-matheus on 2024-11-14 with a locator that matches the issue; the quoted sentence directly supports the layer-adjustment half of chosen_intervention (the iteration-count change is additionally asserted in the same member comment).
